captions.gbp:
Had a scan at Advanced Medical Imaging? Here's what happens next. A board-certified radiologist reads every image, and your doctor usually gets the report within 48 to 72 hours, with same-day reads available for urgent cases. Your doctor then explains what it means and what comes next. You can also view your report and images yourself in our patient portal, or ask for a CD of your images at the front desk after your exam, so it's easy to share them with a specialist or another doctor. Under HIPAA you have the right to copies of your health records, including images (HHS.gov). Good questions to ask your doctor: What did the scan show, in plain words? Do I need another test or a follow-up? Was it compared with my older scans? Tip: bring CDs or reports from scans done elsewhere so we can compare.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.
